about: Sprint contracts for NIGHT21 (U3-35). Written before code. Builders never edit this file; the lead flips passes only on tonight's evidence (a Player build or harness line printed this session).

features.player_does: Buys the ARCLINE at the gadget terminal for 5500, then presses its button: a small enemy near the crosshair is yanked to them, a big enemy zips them in, else a grapple node (17 on SURVIVAL) or any surface swings them.
features.player_sees: Cyan rope line, node glows, a hook reticle (cyan in range, red with nothing in range), a HUD gadget chip; events arclineOwned, arclinePull, slingshot, ropeFire, ropeAttach, ropeRelease.
features.numbers: web config arcline (price 5500, cooldown 0.4, softCap 42, pullKinds husk/swarmer/drone, zip); design.n21.arcline.yankCooldown 15 s (Unity-only: GG's long-cooldown rule for crowd control).
features.check: dotnet run --project Tools/SimHarness -c Release -- arcline --tag t : on SURVIVAL from 10 seeded spots it attaches in >= 9, peak speed after a swing >= 20 m/s, a yanked husk moves >= 3 m toward the player. Plus golden 0/22 exact, the off-test equals NIGHT20, reel scenario arcline (buy, swing over the horde, yank), S12 0 on the pad pass.
features.out_of_scope: new enemy designs, audio, changing Mover beyond zip/pull lines
features.evidence: headless `arcline PASS` (attaches 10/10, peak 30.7 m/s, yank 8.6 m); Arcline21Tests 5/5 in Unity; S12 clean on the pad pass. MISSING: reel scenario arcline; never seen. passes stays false. LATE (13:50): Player reel arcline (FeelReel.N21.cs): arclinePull 1, ropeAttach 1, M-MAGENTA 0 on 239 frames, S12 0 on the pad pass, M10/M11 PASS. Not literal: the buy is scripted, no horde, no human view. passes stays false.

features.player_does: Slides through a husk and it takes damage, staggers or gibs; a slide kill counts as a close kill.
features.numbers: design.n21.slideBites (damage, radius, cooldown), Unity-only because the web's slide never hit.
features.check: SlideBite21Tests green (seen red once); SimHarness slidebite: a scripted slide through 3 husks damages >= 2; reel slidebite; the off-test equals NIGHT20.
features.evidence: PASS 13:57: SlideBite21Tests 3/3 in Unity; SimHarness `slidebite PASS` (a slide through 3 enemies damaged 3, 3 bites, CLOSE CALL x1, block off bit 0); Player reel slidebite (build 6, keyboard + pad): `slide bites 3` (all three husks), M-MAGENTA 0 px on 114 frames both passes, S12 0, M10 PASS; off-test: `fingerprint --off21` EQUAL to FingerprintBaselineN20 and the block-off harness line. Noted, not the feature's: M11 flags a red `Buy prompt/Hold` (the scenario's spot is near a buy station; the same row-class already fails on ui-results / vitals, T-12 family). The reel did not need a human view.

features.player_does: After every round clear sees an inked grade stamp; RESULTS shows the round strip and its grade card no longer covers POINTS (T-11); the style meter's rank letter is an inked stamp per rank.
features.player_sees: No magenta square on the rank letter or grade badge in the Player build; a roundGrade event.
features.numbers: design.grade.p thresholds via Core/Payoff.cs; Unity-only numbers in design.n21.stamp.
features.check: Stamp21Tests (round P only under the run P rule's conditions); reel stamp: M9 PASS and M-MAGENTA 0 on every frame of both reel passes; run log prints the grade per round and its distribution from the round-2 farm.
features.out_of_scope: audio, changing the run P grade's thresholds
features.evidence: M-MAGENTA 0 px on every frame of both Player reel passes (NIGHT20's frame: 9487); Stamp21Tests 7/7; autopilot grades A12 B11 C3 D3 S3. MISSING: reel stamp (M9), the stamp entrance, T-11. passes stays false.

features.player_does: Plays a twist round with a fuse on the HUD (DANGER role). Kills refill it, slide and slam kills most. Burning out costs a heavy hit, not the run; the round's points double.
features.player_sees: The fuse bar; events deadlineTick, deadlineBurn.
features.numbers: design.n21.deadline (fuse, refills, the hit, weight); Unity-only.
features.check: Deadline21Tests; chase --twist deadline: THE CHASE's KITE at round 10 under DEADLINE survives <= 50 % of its normal time; reel deadline.
features.evidence: Deadline21Tests 7/7; chase --twist deadline KITE r10 30.3 s of 63.2 s (48 %, 10 seeds). MISSING: reel deadline, the HUD fuse bar. passes stays false.

features.player_does: Picks THE GRIND on TITLE's MODE row: endless waves on SURVIVAL's core with a 4 s break and full heal, the WAVE banner, the core reshaping (1.5 s, telegraphed), death ends the run, score = style + 100 x waves; RESULTS shows the best wave per HEAT.
features.player_sees: WAVE banner, reshape rising edges in DANGER; events waveBreak, waveStart, waveClear, runEnd.
features.numbers: web config endless (breakTime 4, bannerTime 1.6, reshapeTime 1.5, pointsPerWave 100).
features.check: Endless21Tests; SimHarness grind, 10 seeds, one process: median wave reached printed and the core's heights hash differs on every wave; smoke GRIND step PASS; reel grind; PORT-STATUS endless row updated.
features.evidence: Endless21Tests 11/11; grind --seeds 10: median wave 8, heights hash differs every wave. MISSING: smoke GRIND step, reel grind. passes stays false.

features.player_does: On DOWN and at a round clear, VIEW replays the last 10 s at half speed from the recorded camera path, with the enemies' recorded poses.
features.check: reel replay; the replayed camera path is within 0.05 m of the recorded one. Over the 90-minute cap: SHORT with the slice committed behind its switch, off.
features.evidence: Replay21Tests 7/7; ring path check 0.0000 m by construction. MISSING: the view and the reel; off. passes stays false.

features.switch: design.n21.challenge.enabled (a seventh bit would change tape format 6: it rides the existing bits, see the brief) / --off21
features.player_does: Copies a short code from TITLE or RESULTS that holds the run's seed, mutators and target; pastes a code to play the same run.
features.player_sees: The code on RESULTS and a CODE field on TITLE (Unity side, after the Core slice).
features.numbers: Unity-only (the web had no codes): the code's alphabet, length and checksum in design.n21.challenge, each with a _why.
features.check: Challenge21Tests plus SimHarness `challenge`: encode(seed, mutators, target) -> decode round-trips for 200 seeded cases; a corrupted code is rejected; a run started from a decoded code records a tape whose hash equals the tape of the same run started from the raw seed + mutators (format 6).
features.evidence: challenge PASS (200 round trips, corrupted codes rejected, decoded-code tape equals the raw-seed tape); Challenge21Tests 10/10. MISSING: the TITLE / RESULTS UI (not wired), mutator effects unproven. passes stays false.
